name: zeffect_anim_queue_cmd_type3_position_ref_and_velocity
description: zEffectAnim::QueueCmdType3PositionRefAndVelocity queues or dispatches a type-3 activation record containing a position reference and velocity vector.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this activation-record helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffect activation/source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja HLIL still collapses part of the queue/dispatch PHI after the ref-node stack slot is reused, so functional evidence is tied to the inspected assembly, MLIL, and native smoke.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x461ba0 validates bound-node and reference-node token lookup, queue and dispatch gating from entry flags plus valid node/name checks, AllocActivationRecord, commandType=3, strncpy of the 32-byte animation name, nodeToken/refNodeToken storage, nullable refVec copy into params[1..3], nullable velocityVec copy into params[4..6], optional dispatch callback invocation, DiscardLastActivationRecord when not queued, and returning the dispatch record or null.

The native zEffect activation-record smoke verifies queued type-3 record creation after prior records, commandType=3, returned table slot, queue count growth, null ref-node token, ref-vector payload, and velocity-vector payload.
